info.title: HelpCenterApp
info.description: Unified API contract for ASAP, Employee Self Service, and Feedback Widget help center apps, including employee self-service app initialization details.

get.description: Returns the user, organization, Employee Self Service app, and static asset details required to initialize the employee self-service app. This is an internal API.

get.summary: Retrieves a list of ASAPs, Employee Self Service apps, and Feedback Widgets, with pagination support.
get.description: Retrieves a list of ASAPs, Employee Self Service apps, and Feedback Widgets, with pagination support.

parameters.name: depId
parameters.description: ID of the department to filter ASAP. ID of the department to filter the app list.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number starting from which the ASAPs must be listed. Index number starting from which the apps must be listed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of ASAPs to list. Number of apps to list.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field by which the list is sorted. Possible values: appName, modifiedTime.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filters by app status. Possible values: true = active apps, false = inactive apps.

parameters.name: isAsc
parameters.description: Indicates whether to sort in ascending order. Possible values: true = ascending, false = descending.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filters apps by type. Possible values: ASAP, EMPLOYEE_SELF_SERVICE, FEEDBACK_WIDGET. Use EMPLOYEE_SELF_SERVICE to list Employee Self Service apps. Use FEEDBACK_WIDGET to list Feedback Widget apps.

post.description: Creates an ASAP, Employee Self Service, or Feedback Widget app. The required type property selects and validates only the corresponding request schema, and the returned type selects the corresponding response schema.

get.description: Gets an ASAP, Employee Self Service, or Feedback Widget app. The response type discriminator selects and validates only the matching response schema.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the help center app. This value is supplied in the request path.

patch.description: Updates an existing ASAP, Employee Self Service, or Feedback Widget app. First retrieve the app by appId and use the update schema that matches its returned type: UpdateAsapRequest for ASAP, UpdateAgentPortalRequest for EMPLOYEE_SELF_SERVICE, or UpdateFeedbackWidgetRequest for FEEDBACK_WIDGET. The update payload is type-less because the server derives the type from appId. Do not send one app type's modules or appProperties while updating another app type. The response type discriminator selects the matching response schema.
